senses.gloss: āḍa, aḍḍa (CITD), Telugu; a measure of capacity equal to 2 mānikas or one-eighth of a tūm; half, especially half of a fanam or a certain measure called kuñcamu; a weight representing the eighteenth portion of a varāha (q. v.).
āḍa , also spelt aḍḍa; name of a coin; half of a fanam; cf. aḍḍaga and aḍḍuga.
āḍāṇaka (LP), same as aḍḍāṇaka; cf. āḍāṇake muktā, mortgaged; valitāya āḍāṇake muktam, Gujarātī val̤at dāṇ mukyuṃ, ‘something morgaged, the produce of which will pay off the debt in course of time’.
aḍḍāṇaka (LP), a mortgaged thing; cf. gṛh-āḍḍāṇaka-patra (LP), deed for mortgaging a house.
aḍḍa-cinna , cf. āḍa or aḍḍa and cinna or sinna.
aḍḍaga, aḍḍuga (CITD), Telugu; half a fanam.
aḍḍaga , also spelt aḍḍuga; same as āḍa, aḍḍa.
aḍatālīsa-gānī , 6 aṭha-gānīs; billon coin equal to the silver ṭaṅka and to 48 copper jitals.
